name: PISA
description: PISA is a large-scale dataset introduced to support prompt-based time series forecasting (PromptCast), a new paradigm that transforms numerical input and output into prompts for language models. It includes three real-world forecasting scenarios and enables evaluation of language generation models against state-of-the-art numerical forecasting methods.
reputation: A recent prompt-based time series forecasting dataset that is mainly used in the PromptCast line of work and has limited broader community adoption so far.
notes: Transforms forecasting into a sentence-to-sentence task using prompts; shows better generalization under zero-shot settings compared to conventional methods.
